nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit `location` (5-digit ZIP — RealtyAPI only supports by-ZIP search) and `limit` before running. `searchType` allowed values per the OpenAPI spec: For_Sale, For_Rent, Sold (comma-separated combos allowed). `propertyType` defaults to House — condos/apartments have no backyard for a pergola.

nodes.name: 1. RealtyAPI Search By Zip
nodes.notes: Params per the endpoint's OpenAPI spec: searchType (For_Sale/For_Rent/Sold), sortOrder, propertyType, resultCount (default 50, max 200). Response wrapped as [{searchResults: [...]}]. Set your real key in the x-realtyapi-key header value (Headers tab) before running.

nodes.name: 3. Imagery, Vision, Filter & Postcard
nodes.notes: Coordinates come embedded in RealtyAPI records; Google Geocoding runs only as a per-property fallback inside this node. Both API keys AND the vision model slug are edited directly at the top of this node's code — no separate Config node needed for anything in here.

nodes.name: 4. Backyard Render, Panorama & Teaser Video
nodes.notes: Generates a backyard-with-pergola render and a 360° panorama for every qualified lead (OpenRouter Image API). The 5-second teaser video (Seedance 2.0 Fast, OpenRouter Video API) only runs if GENERATE_VIDEO is set to true at the top of this node's code — it's an async job that takes minutes and is billed per generation, so leave it off until you've reviewed a lead and want to send it. Render/video failures don't drop the lead — the postcard text still goes through.
